reason: `delil-server users create` prints a password it generated exactly once to the operator's own terminal (stdout), as `bootstrap` does; it is never written to the server log. Pass a password on stdin to avoid generation.

The request log is written through log/slog's JSON or text handler, which escape quotes, control characters and newlines in every value, so a client cannot forge log lines. The request id and trace id are additionally validated against strict patterns.

HashToken stores SHA-256 of API keys and session tokens, whose secret part is 256 bits from crypto/rand. A slow password hash only helps against guessable inputs; for uniformly random 256-bit secrets SHA-256 is preimage-resistant and lets every request authenticate in constant time. User passwords use Argon2id (internal/auth/password.go).
